organization.name: Kevin Papst / Kimai business
organization.notes: Commercial activity founded2018 according to official press FAQ; original Kimai release2006 and maintainer involvement2009 are earlier project history. Single founder Kevin Papst; explicitly no external investment. Sole-trader business, not inferred corporation.

pricingTiers.name: Self-hosted core
pricingTiers.notes: Software license fee0; infrastructure and optional paid plugins separate. Core includes time tracking, reporting and invoicing.

pricingTiers.name: Professional
pricingTiers.notes: Explicit Most popular. €4.99/user monthly, or €47.88/user annual payment; cloud scope, not self-host license.

pricingTiers.name: Professional
pricingTiers.notes: Closest growing-team/company plan; same Professional plan as popular role, not an additional tier. Optional self-host plugin prices vary.
No separate enterprise pricing tier verified; Professional is highest public cloud plan in reviewed offer.

moats.claim: Custom invoice templates, rate rules and time/project history can create workflow switching costs; extensibility offers more defensibility than the basic timer alone.

productReasons.claim: Customer/project management and multiple billing rates accommodate different client and work charging arrangements.
Core invoicing turns recorded billable and non-billable time into client-ready billing records.
Reports and PDF/spreadsheet exports let teams review work and pass timesheets into financial workflows.

sponsorship.notes: No separate corporate financial/in-kind sponsor identified in reviewed official project and business pages. Verified commercial steward included as business fallback; customers, partners and investors are not classified as sponsors.

requirements.notes: Oldest maintained LTS or newer; current README gives MariaDB>=10.6.
Current README gives MySQL>=8.4; SQLite/PostgreSQL not asserted.
Choose one compatible web server; subdomain required rather than subdirectory.
Native installation/administration tooling. Packaged Docker route alternative; FTP upload unsupported.
Alternative to native PHP installation; multi-step Compose/Caddy setup is not a one-click installer.
Mail delivery requires a relay; no mandatory external Redis/search/queue/object-store established for core.

resources.os: Linux server; Docker hosts or compatible PHP web hosting with SSH
resources.notes: Only explicit documented hardware figures included; null means no minimum verified in reviewed installation source.

selfHosting.notes: Current Kimai2 requirements from maintained README and installation guide. No SQLite alternative. Native PHP route or Docker; external database remains required. Old1.14 docs list third-party one-click providers but current official installer no longer endorses them, so no shortcut asserted.

oneClickInstall.notes: Reviewed official installation instructions; no current first-party or officially linked one-click or one-command installer verified. Manual package/Compose instructions excluded.
